results.title: Mfantsipim @150 gala honours Alex Apau Dadey and other distinguished alumni
results.content: Mfantsipim School has honoured distinguished alumni, members of staff and corporate partners at its 150th anniversary Awards and Fundraising Dinner, held on Saturday, October 31, 2026. The event brought together old boys, invited guests, institutional partners and corporate leaders to celebrate the school's 150-year contribution to education and national development while raising funds towards its long-term development priorities. A major highlight of the evening was the recognition of individuals whose achievements and contributions reflect the school's values and traditions. Executive Chairman of KGL Group, Alex Apau Dadey, received two honours — the Partner of Impact Award and a special category award recognising his contributions to Mfantsipim.
